extraction_notes: Only main-text Figure 10 contains plotted catalytic performance data. Figures 1–8 are characterization plots/images, and Figure 9 is in situ DRIFTS; these were skipped. Figure 10a,b temperature series reports CO2 conversion and CH3OH selectivity for 5PC, 5P5ZC, and 0.5Ca5P5ZC. Figure 10c pressure series and Figure 10d stability series are for 0.5Ca5P5ZC and include CO selectivity on the right selectivity axis. Values were read visually from the plotted markers; all plotted quantities use qualifier '~'.
